0022600134.text: The Detroit Pistons (3-1, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-1, 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East) in the Pistons' 5th game of the season, with Detroit coming off a loss while Charlotte is on a two-game winning streak. The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 118-100 win in Charlotte on April 10, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series. Detroit will be without Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision, while Charlotte is missing Coby White (out, calf strain), Grant Williams (out, hamstring), Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (out, knee, surgery).
